title: Nuevo Laredo Gears Up to Welcome Thousands of Paisanos for the Holidays
excerpt: Nuevo Laredo launched its part of Operativo Invierno 2026 on Nov. 25, with an information module, free tow trucks, paramedics and guided caravans ready for the paisanos crossing through the busiest border gateway in Tamaulipas.
content:
Nuevo Laredo is getting ready to welcome thousands of paisanos coming home for the holidays, as the city joined the official launch of Operativo Invierno 2026 on Tuesday, Nov. 25, according to El Gráfico Tamaulipas.

Mayor Carmen Lilia Canturosas Villarreal accompanied Gov. Américo Villarreal Anaya in Reynosa for the launch of the winter operation, part of the Heroínas y Héroes Paisanos program, which brings together all three levels of government to provide safety, guidance and assistance to Mexicans returning to the country for the December holidays.

The operation runs from Nov. 25, 2026, through Jan. 8, 2027, with more than 40 government agencies taking part. The mayor stressed that Nuevo Laredo is one of Mexico’s main entry points and the border crossing with the largest paisano flow in Tamaulipas. In the previous period, more than 47,000 paisanos entered through this border, about 70 percent of all those who crossed through Tamaulipas.

The city will set up an information module at the Centro de Internación Temporal de Vehículos (CITEV), in the Migration area, where visitors can get guidance on services, lodging options and tourist attractions, including the Zoo and Aquarium, the Science, Technology and Planetarium Museum, the Cultural Center and Estación Palabra, along with the city’s plazas, parks and food.

The Traffic Department will provide guidance at the busiest roadways, adjust traffic-light timing to keep vehicles moving, and make two free tow trucks available for roadside help. Civil Protection will set up an operations command center at the CITEV, staff a paramedic unit, run patrols out to kilometer 26, offer basic mechanical assistance and organize accompanied caravans together with Transit and Citizen Security so travelers have a safe trip. The Tourism Department will staff the information module and hand out welcome materials.

The mayor said the city wants paisanos who cross through this border to find everything they need to continue their journey — and to take away a good memory of Nuevo Laredo, a city that welcomes them with open arms.

Sources: El Gráfico Tamaulipas — “Suma Gobierno de Carmen Lilia Canturosas esfuerzos con Gobernador Américo Villarreal para recibir a miles de paisanos”, Nov. 25, 2026, https://elgraficotam.com.mx/2026/11/25/suma-gobierno-de-carmen-lilia-canturosas-esfuerzos-con-gobernador-americo-villarreal-para-recibir-a-miles-de-paisanos/
